strings.＠Chiyuru_T\\n不用花钱就能看书，\\n所以我经常借来打发时间。\\n:
＠Chiyuru_T
You can read without spending money,
so I borrow books to pass the time.
The library even has some titles that only exist in print.
strings.＠Chiyuru_T\\n说好不提这个的！！: ＠Chiyuru_T\nWe agreed not to bring that up!!
strings.＠Rami_K\\n不过，拉米同学会读书这一点，\\n我确实也觉得有些意外呢。: ＠Rami_K\nStill, the fact that Rami-san reads\nhonestly surprised me a little.
strings.＠Rami_K\\n然而成绩却不太看得出成果，\\n这就是拉米酱。: ＠Rami_K\nAnd yet it never really shows in her grades.\nThat's Rami-chan for you.
strings.＠Rami_K\\n说起来，之前看到拉米酱在图书馆呢。\\n你经常去吗？: ＠Rami_K\nSpeaking of which, I saw Rami-chan in the library the other day.\nDo you go there often?
strings.＠T_Commander\\n也没到爱读书那种程度啦。虽然读的数量确实不少。: ＠T_Commander\nIt's not like I love reading that much. Though I do get through a fair number of books.
